data.title: Muraba Veil
data.about:
Muraba Veil, Dubai Canal, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is set to transform Dubai’s skyline with its extraordinary design, becoming the second-thinnest skyscraper in the world. Standing at an impressive height of 1,247 feet but only 74 feet wide, it redefines luxury living with a slender silhouette that houses a single apartment per floor. The exterior is wrapped in a custom-designed stainless steel “veil” that not only enhances the building’s sleek, modern look but also serves as a functional feature to optimize privacy while allowing natural light to flood the interiors. This innovative facade captures the changing colors of the sky, creating a dynamic, ever-evolving visual experience.

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road and overlooking the Dubai Canal, Muraba Veil at Al Wasl by Muraba Properties offers a collection of 131 luxurious apartments with two to five bedrooms. Inspired by traditional Arabian architecture, the residences are arranged around internal courtyards enriched with greenery, providing a serene retreat in the heart of the city. The project includes exclusive amenities such as a spa, a private movie theater, a gallery, a restaurant, and even a padel court, ensuring a holistic lifestyle that blends culture, luxury, and modern convenience.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Elevated Living Along the Dubai Canal
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Super-Thin Skyscraper: Muraba Veil features a uniquely narrow design that dedicates each floor to a single apartment, ensuring unparalleled privacy.
  • Innovative Design: The building is enveloped in a distinctive stainless steel “veil” that reflects the changing colors of the sky while optimizing privacy.
  • Inspired by Arabian Architecture: Rooted in local culture, Muraba Veil draws inspiration from traditional Arabian houses, with apartments arranged around serene internal courtyards.
  • Prime Location: Located in the heart of Dubai, United Arab Emirates, Muraba Veil offers spectacular views of the Dubai skyline and easy access to the city's key attractions.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents can indulge in a range of curated amenities, including a spa, private movie theater, gallery, restaurant, and padel court.

location_tile.title: A Tranquil Environment at the Heart of the City's Dynamic Energy
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Muraba Veil is strategically situated in Al Wasl, along the vibrant Dubai Canal, offering residents breathtaking views of the city’s skyline and the tranquil waters below. Positioned near the bustling Sheikh Zayed Road, the tower provides seamless connectivity to Dubai’s major landmarks, like Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. The area is well-connected by major roadways and other parts of the city, including the iconic Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the lively Jumeirah Beach.

  • 6 Minutes to Safa Park
  • 7 Minutes to Business Bay Metro Station
  • 9 Minutes to Al Habtoor Palace
  • 10 Minutes to Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Waterfront
  • 10 Minutes to the Museum of the Future

more_info.question: What makes Muraba Veil unique in Dubai?

more_info.answer: Muraba Veil is located along the scenic Dubai Canal, near Sheikh Zayed Road, offering easy access to major attractions like Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa.
more_info.question: Where is Muraba Veil located?

more_info.answer: The project features 131 luxury apartments ranging from two to five bedrooms, each occupying the entire width of the building for maximum privacy and panoramic views.
more_info.question: What types of residences are available at Muraba Veil?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy exclusive amenities, including a spa, private movie theater, art gallery, restaurant, padel court, swimming pool, and fitness center.
